provenance.objective: R(w) = duration-weighted ROOT disagreement + duration-weighted KEY-vs-LOCAL disagreement, pooled over the training-fold complement, on the robust unit (CLAUDE.md block (A)) through the pinned a8/compare_rn chain. User ruling 2026-07-19: the search objective is M2 - the equal-weighted sum of the two primary axes. Roman numeral and key-home are recorded beside it and never enter it.
provenance.method: coordinate line search on a declared multiplicative grid, with random restarts - the published minimum-error-rate protocol (Och 2003, ACL). The ONE declared approximation to that protocol: Och searches each coordinate line EXACTLY by an upper-envelope sweep over the candidate set; here each line is searched on the declared grid below. Deterministic given the start; strict improvement only.
provenance.zero_probe: stage 0 additionally offers 0.0 for every coordinate, so 'the metric rejects this factor' is reachable; a coordinate already at 0 is offered the absolute re-entry grid (0.05, 0.25, 1.0) against the incumbent's unit scale
provenance.bounds_note: the decode is scale-invariant (established at runtime), so the UPPER bound cannot bind: any ray with non-negative components rescales into the box. The declared box therefore constrains exactly NON-NEGATIVITY, which is the theory-grounded part (each factor is a log-probability of the generative form; a negative weight would assert the counted table actively misleads). Iterates are held at max-component 1.0, so no clip ever fires.
provenance.decoder: probe_decoder.decode_piece's own lattice (fit_weights.build_unit, augment_gt=False), re-decoded by the max-plus recursion in this module; established at runtime to reproduce decode_piece's score AND segmentation exactly
provenance.grading: probe_run.decode_to_regions -> probe_run.grade_regions -> a8_rebaseline_measure.build_piece_grid vs dcml_parser.load_wir_regions - the pinned chain, unmodified
provenance.firewall: the objective is a TRAINING-fold error quantity, lawfully consulted by the optimizer per the ratified fallback; this module never constructs a held-out stem list (grade_stems is its only grading call site and training_stems its only stem source). Held-out evaluation is search_run.py, once per fold, downstream, feeding nothing back.
